# MCP tools: app-only

<!-- description: The MCP tools that only the MCP App rooms call to show and edit records. Claude cannot see or call them, and they check the same scopes as every other tool. -->

<!-- Generated by `sidekick.mcp.export_tool_reference` from `contracts/mcp-tools.generated.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

[MCP tool reference](index.md) | 25 tools.

These tools are declared with `visibility: ["app"]`. The MCP App rooms call them to show and edit records; the model never sees them, so Claude cannot call them. They check the same scopes as every other tool.

## Tasks and boards

### `reorder_work_board_column`

App-only.

Returns: `BoardReorderResult` with `items` (array of BoardPlacementRecord).
